name: delegate
description: A hand_off tool: Claude gives a self-contained task to a cheaper worker model (Haiku) that stays warm between tasks, with where the change reaches from the language server, the diff and a check run by the tool as evidence, a review by the main model, and a log of what it saved and how often the work came back.

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Turn this mod off or on; /mods does it for all of the pack.

readWorker.title: Worker for read work
readWorker.description: Model and effort for hand-offs that change no file (find, list, trace, explain), e.g. haiku or haiku:low.

mechanicalWorker.title: Worker for mechanical edits
mechanicalWorker.description: Model and effort for edits the task spells out completely (a rename, one change applied everywhere, moving code), e.g. haiku:low.

buildWorker.title: Worker for build work
buildWorker.description: Model and effort for edits with something left to work out (a feature from a spec, tests to a target), e.g. sonnet:medium.

wait.title: How hand_off waits by default
wait.description: tool: the call holds the turn until the worker is done and returns its report with the evidence (fewest requests of the main model). message: it returns at once and the report arrives as a message. Claude can choose either per call with the tool's background flag.

framing.title: How the tool is offered
framing.description: hand_off: a tool that outsources a task to a cheaper worker. capability: the same work offered as implement_spec(spec, check), a tool that implements a precisely specified change and proves it, without the word delegation.

afterPlan.title: After a plan is approved
afterPlan.description: hand_off: when you approve a plan of 20 lines or more, Claude is told to implement it through a hand-off, the plan as the worker's spec (measured: followed 8 of 8 times; feature and test work cost 22-26% less). off: Claude implements it itself.

review.title: Review route
review.description: Who reads an edit hand-off's evidence. inline (default): the main model, in its next step. fork: one forked request of the main model returns a verdict and only the verdict enters the context. auto: fork when the evidence is larger than about a 60th of the context. In the benchmark forks cost far more than reading inline, so inline is the default.

reuseMinutes.title: Keep a worker warm (minutes)
reuseMinutes.description: A follow-up hand-off within this time continues the same worker, its earlier reading still in its context.

workerContextCap.title: Worker context cap (tokens)
workerContextCap.description: A worker whose requests have grown past this size is not continued; the next hand-off starts a fresh one.
